1.

We speak to you of God’s grace, So boundless, so free, and so rich, But what shall it avail your soul, If it is not received by you?

2.

We speak of the great salvation, Which the Father in Jesus has made known, But if you will live for God, In faith you must receive it.

3.

We speak of the Saviour’s name, By which God reaches sinners. Lost you nevertheless shall be, If on that name you do not believe.

4.

We speak of the Lamb, whose blood Now makes you free from sins. If you have not proved its power, Eternally unclean you shall remain.

5.

We speak of great glory, Of heavens of light and of peace, But if you do not believe in Jesus, You shall not, you cannot there dwell.
